title: Machine Learning for Shape Memory Graphene Nanoribbons and Applications in Biomedical Engineering.
summary: An active-learning moment-tensor interatomic potential trained against DFT extends shape-memory analysis to graphene-oxide nanoribbons; the source reports a width-dependent suppression of the metastable phase and checks the potential against DFT calculations. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
